plan.title: sec: AppSec — migrate symlink secret copy; reconcile confused-deputy; check-updates SSRF

narratives.Description: Four operator/agent task paths trust repo-controlled inputs past the project trust boundary: migrate:xbrief can follow a planted vbrief symlink and copy local secrets; reconcile labels/umbrellas can mutate foreign GitHub issues; framework:check-updates can probe a manifest-controlled remote. Each sink needs fail-closed remediation plus regression tests.
narratives.Overview: Four operator/agent task paths trust repo-controlled inputs past the project trust boundary. Remediate each sink with fail-closed checks and regression tests.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator running migrate or reconcile or check-updates, I want repo-controlled inputs unable to exfiltrate secrets or mutate foreign issues or probe arbitrary remotes, so that a malicious tree cannot abuse my token or host egress.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts: lstat/symlink reject and realpath containment under project root.
2. packages/core/src/vbrief-reconcile/labels.ts and umbrellas.ts: same-repo/allowlist before mutate; cross-repo read-only by default.
3. packages/core/src/check-updates/index.ts: pin to canonical/allowlisted upstream; reject private/link-local hosts.
4. Add regression tests per sink; CHANGELOG. Closes #2601.
narratives.Acceptance: Findings 1–4 remediated with tests; no cross-repo mutate by default; no symlink secret copy; no manifest SSRF to private hosts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a planted vbrief symlink outside the project, when migrate:xbrief runs, then it rejects without copying secret contents into xbrief/.
Given an xBRIEF with a cross-repo issue URI, when vbrief:reconcile:labels runs without an explicit cross-repo flag, then it refuses label mutation on the foreign repo.
Given an epic xBRIEF pointing at a foreign issue, when vbrief:reconcile:umbrellas runs, then comment create/edit is refused (cross-repo read-only by default).
Given a planted VERSION/manifest with a private or non-allowlisted url, when framework:check-updates runs, then git ls-remote is not issued to that host.
Given the four sinks, when the suite runs, then symlink plant, cross-repo URI, and manifest URL cases are covered.
